description: Answers the format of a DIYA-GL book: its two files, book.toml (the business, the period, the chart of accounts, the tax settings and the registers) and lines.jsonl (one transaction line a row), each field with its type and meaning, and the published schemas. With part ct600 it answers the Company Tax Return (CT600) box map instead: each box's number, label, section and format, narrowed to one section when section is given. Use this when you are about to read or change lines of a DIYA-GL book, or when the person asks what a CT600 box holds. It does not read a DIYA-GL book or change anything.

part.description: book (the default) for the DIYA-GL book format, ct600 for the CT600 box map

section.description: With part ct600, the CT600 section to narrow the boxes to, such as Tax calculation

name: book_format
title: Describe the DIYA-GL book format
